name: 60 DOGFOOD — Deploy BKC on OpenStack VM
summary: Deploy BlackKnightController onto an OpenStack-side Debian VM like a regular user: mount ns1 runtime, render .env/compose, run Docker Compose, validate readiness, and publish the new edge pointer.

dashboards.name: OpenStack Horizon

notes: This pipeline intentionally uses Docker Compose first. It is the simplest dogfood migration lane: ns1 remains the shared runtime/NFS source, .env stays out of Git, and the pipeline performs the same steps a regular operator would run by hand. The edge pointer should use a new proxy/NAT port such as 8090 labeled BlackKnightController — OpenStack, not replace the current BKC route during validation.
